concerns.text: FR-009 requires extracting grain size features for the 'test set' to ensure comparative analysis uses exact same instances. Task T022 extracts features for 'every image' in Phase 2 (Foundational), BEFORE the train/val/test split occurs in Phase 3 (T013). This creates a data leakage risk where test features are processed before isolation, violating the spec's isolation requirement. A task to extract features specifically for the split test set post-T013 is missing.

FR-001 and US-1 mandate downloading a 'public microstructure-strength dataset'. The Plan explicitly rejects this in favor of a 'Synthetic-to-Real' methodology. While T040/T041 in Phase 7 attempt to fix this, there is NO task in the main execution flow (Phases 1-6) that implements the synthetic data generation as the primary source. T011 attempts to download from HuggingFace/Zenodo (which the Plan says doesn't exist). The core data ingestion task for the actual methodology (Synthetic) is missing from the main pipeline.

SC-005 requires measuring interpretability validity via 'IoU between Grad-CAM and manually annotated grain boundaries' OR 'expert review report'. Task T030 replaces this with a 'Pearson correlation' proxy, explicitly stating manual annotations don't exist. However, the Plan (Phase 5, T030) explicitly includes an 'Expert Review Protocol' as the alternative. The Task list T030 implements only the statistical proxy and omits the 'Expert Review Protocol' task required by the Plan to satisfy SC-005.

FR-007 and US-3 Scenario 2 define the sensitivity analysis threshold as the 'median predicted strength of the test set'. Task T031 implements the sweep using the 'Ground Truth Median'. This is a mathematical deviation from the spec's requirement. While the Plan (Phase 5, T031) also mentions 'median threshold sweep', it does not explicitly correct the spec's 'predicted median' to 'ground truth'. A task explicitly implementing the 'predicted median' threshold as per FR-007 is missing, or the spec/plan needs alignment. Currently, the task implements a different metric than the spec requires.

The Plan's execution flow ends at Phase 6. The critical data source fixes (T040-T042) required to resolve the contradiction between the Spec (download) and Plan (synthetic) are isolated in 'Phase 7: Revision & Correction'. There is no task in Phases 0-6 that integrates the synthetic generator as the primary data source. The project cannot execute the Plan's methodology without completing Phase 7, but Phase 7 is not part of the defined execution flow. A task to integrate the synthetic generator into the main pipeline (replacing T011) is missing from the primary phases.

Task T024 implements a 'paired t-test' and includes a note claiming the Spec (FR-005) was 'incorrect' for requiring a 'single-sample t-test'. While the paired t-test is statistically sound for paired errors, the task list unilaterally overrides a specific Functional Requirement without a formal change request or justification recorded in the Spec/Plan. This creates a traceability break where the task does not map to the FR as written.
